name: Cupriferous-Voe
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past crystal cavern networks, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Trade at the pirate hideout changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
